title: bus.dlq.summary v1
description: Periodic rollup published by the DLQ drain adapter (adapters/dlq/dlq.py) describing dead-letter volume by channel and failure reason over a window. NEVER carries payload bytes -- original_payload_excerpt is private (may contain trading/credential data) and must never appear here; this event is channel + reason + count only.

window_start.description: RFC3339 UTC start of the accumulation window

window_end.description: RFC3339 UTC end of the accumulation window (publish time)

total_count.description: Total dead letters drained in this window

by_channel.description: Per (original_type, failure_reason) counts observed in this window. No payload content.

since_start_total.description: Cumulative total since the drain process started, for trend context
